from.place: Exact-functor finite evaluation factorization in the finite pullback counit projection.

title: Finite evaluation factors followed by an arbitrary chain map
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, a complex $C$ of strict quotient systems, and $n\geq0$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let $N$ be any complex of $A_{E,n+1}$-module sheaves on $Y$, and $k:C_n\to N$ any chain map. Write $F$ for system pullback, $V_X,V_Y$ for finite evaluation, and $B$ for ordinary finite constant-ring pullback. Let $H_C:V_XF(C)\to BV_Y(C)$ be the specified ordinary finite evaluation comparison, and $\beta$ its specified derived comparison [lem-pod-finite-system-pullback-coherence]. Write $F_D,V_{X,D},B_D$ for their exact derived functors and $\theta_T:Q\mathbin{\ggg}T_D\simeq T_{\mathrm{complex}}\mathbin{\ggg}Q$, where $\ggg$ denotes functor composition in diagrammatic order, for the exact localization factors, in precisely the direction of Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Then the composite $V_{X,D}(\theta_F(C)^{-1})$, $\beta_{Q(C)}$, $B_D(\theta_{V_Y}(C)\,;\,Q(k))$, and $\theta_B(N)$ equals $\theta_{V_X}(F(C))\,;\,Q(H_C\,;\,B(k))$, with semicolon denoting first the left map and then the right map. This is exactly the equality of finiteEvaluation_fac_comp; no isomorphism hypothesis is imposed on k.

source.place: Tag 015F, lemma-right-derived-exact-functor; exact localization composition and naturality, as implemented by Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors and MapDerivedCategoryMate. The finite system comparison is the specified one of lem-pod-finite-system-pullback-coherence.

proof.text: Unfold the specified derived finite evaluation comparison into the inverse source compositor, the derived ordinary evaluation isomorphism, and the target compositor. The composition and natural-isomorphism factorization identities calculate its component on Q(C) and give finiteEvaluation_fac.

Use naturality of the finite pullback factor at k to move Q(k) through its target factor. Substitute the preceding component equation. The inverse and forward F factors cancel after applying derived evaluation. Functoriality of Q identifies the remaining composite with Q(H_C followed by B(k)).

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEvaluation_fac_comp {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (N : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (k : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ⟶ N) :
  letI := finiteEvaluation_zero l E f n
  let B : normalizedDVRModules l E Y n ⥤ normalizedDVRModules l E X n :=
      proEtaleConstantRingPullback (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f
  let V := coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n
  let F := integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f
  let D := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C
  let H : (V.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D ⟶
      (B.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) :=
      (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (finiteEvaluation l E f n).hom (.up ℤ)).app C
  let VD := coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n
  let BD := proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback
    (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f
  let β : F.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ VD ≅
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ BD :=
    finiteSystemDerivedPullbackEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
      (integralSystemTransition l E) f n
  VD.map (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C) ≫
    β.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≫
    BD.map ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app C ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map k) ≫ B.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app N =
  V.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app D ≫
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (H ≫ (B.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map k)
